Enrich person.name: Jordan L. Wilkinson
Enrich person.title: Director of Service Excellence, Customer Experience & Transformation
Enrich person.summary:
With more than 16 years of global experience leading operations, strategy, and large-scale transformation, I bring a steady, growth-driven approach to building organizations that perform, scale, and last.

I’ve led multi-continent teams across the U.S., India, and the Philippines while living and working in both India and China; driving initiatives that connect strategy to execution. My focus: building efficient systems, empowering people, and turning complexity into clarity. From designing digital operating models to reshaping customer journeys, I’m passionate about creating structures that deliver measurable impact and sustainable growth.

I’m recognized for:

- Scaling global operations that balance agility with control
- Leading transformation across cultures, systems, and business lines
- Driving automation and partnerships that elevate performance
- Championing inclusive, people-first cultures rooted in accountability and trust
- Guiding distributed teams with clarity, empathy, and results

Having traveled to over 40 countries, I bring a truly global perspective. One that values cultural intelligence, adaptability, and innovation. As a proud gay African-American executive, I lead with authenticity and the belief that strong business outcomes start with empowered, inclusive teams.

I’m energized by opportunities that blend strategy, global leadership, and operational transformation, and by organizations ready to evolve with intention and impact.
Enrich person.headline: Global Operations & Customer Experience Executive | Led 500+ Person Teams Across US, India & Manila | Driving AI, Transformation, & Service Excellence

experience.title: Director of Service Excellence, Customer Experience & Transformation
experience.summary:
Executive Impact:
• Built and now leads a 300-person global Service Excellence organization spanning the US and India, integrating Customer Experience, Process Excellence, Workforce Performance, Quality, AI Transformation, and Performance Command Center functions under a single enterprise operating model supporting all major Paychex business units and managing approximately $12M in annual operating budget.  
• Created a transformation framework aligning customer insights, operational redesign, workforce performance, automation, and executive reporting across Paychex business units. 
• Increased Net Promoter Score from 35.0 to 41.6, achieving the organization’s highest customer advocacy levels in recent years. 
• Reduced executive customer escalations by 19% year-over-year in April, and 42% year-over-year in May, improving responsiveness, first contact resolution, and executive stakeholder confidence. 
• Led enterprise-wide operational assessments within the first 90 days, identifying more than $25M in savings opportunities through process redesign, workforce optimization, and transformation initiatives. 
• Established the Performance Command Center and Employee Health Dashboard, creating executive visibility into workforce performance, quality, productivity, coaching opportunities, and enterprise transformation progress.

experience.title: Director of Global Capability Center - Executive Assignment
experience.summary:
Executive Impact: 
• Selected by executive leadership for a six-month international turnaround assignment in Bengaluru, India to stabilize operations, strengthen governance, and restore organizational effectiveness across Paychex’s Global Capability Center supporting six major business units. 
• Served as a key leader in the remediation and stabilization of a 2,000-person organization, partnering with executive leadership and HR to rebuild workforce stability, leadership effectiveness, and stakeholder confidence.  
• Led organizational restructuring efforts that consolidated operations from three facilities into one strategic location, improving efficiency, workforce alignment, and long-term scalability while saving $1.1M annually. 
• Directed enterprise remediation initiatives spanning people, process, technology, risk, and operational effectiveness, successfully transitioning the organization. 
  • Partnered with Senior leaders across the US and India to strengthen organizational health, leadership capability, and execution of strategic transformation initiatives.

experience.title: Director & General Manager of SurePayroll Sales and Service
experience.summary:
Executive Impact:
• Selected to pilot Paychex’s first Director-level General Manager operating model, leading Sales, Service, Business Development, and Marketing functions supporting a 70,000-customer portfolio and $20M+ P&L.
• Delivered 16% year-over-year revenue growth while achieving 95% of annual sales plan performance, driving sustained growth despite evolving market conditions. 
• Reignited and expanded Paychex’s strategic partnership with Truist Bank, securing a multi-year renewal agreement and expanding revenue-generating opportunities. 
• Built and scaled the organization’s first Business Development Representative function, generating more than 1,000 outbound prospecting activities per day and accelerating pipeline growth.
• Led cross-functional transformation initiatives across sales, service, onboarding, and marketing creating scalable operating models that strengthened customer acquisition, retention, and long-term growth.

experience.title: Director of Implementation HCM
experience.summary:
Executive Impact: 
 • Developed Paychex’s three-year Implementation Strategy, optimizing people, process, and technology to improve operational effectiveness and scalability. 
• Designed and automated a client welcome experience serving more than 60,000 Small Business Clients, streamlining onboarding communications and significantly improving client readiness. 
• Surpassed FY24 digital onboarding goals by 166%, increasing adoption from 15,000 to more than 40,000 clients. 
• Established the organization’s first dedicated Quality Assurance function within Implementation, resulting in 90% of clients successfully transitioning to ongoing service with standards met. 
• Delivered global process optimization initiatives within six months of launch, improving throughput, quality, and operational performance across implementation workflows. 
 
Leadership & Recognition:
• Completed the 2024 Mckinsey & Company Executive Leadership Program sponsored by Paychex
• Nominated to serve as the Director Sponsor for WIN, the first ever International Women’s Initiative Network EBRG within Paychex 
• Lead the 2024 Black History Month Signature Event for 3,000 + Employees featuring Johnny Simmons, Marla & Angela Gibbs

experience.title: Senior Director of Operations
experience.summary:
During the COVID pandemic at Gusto, I championed success and resilience while contributing to the company's remarkable $9.5 billion valuation. As a leader in payroll, benefits, and HR technology, Gusto's commitment to user-centric design and cutting edge solutions has established it as a trusted partner for entrepreneurs and HR professionals alike. 

Key Accomplishments: 

•Scaled department  headcount by 283% in 12 months to meet post-pandemic growth across Qualification, Submission & Confirmation 
•Designed and launched department reorganization focused on five key areas in three months which increased internal employee mobility by 68% (Key Areas: Quality, Standardization, Training, Throughput & Employee Empowerment) 
•Reduced overall processing times on Qualification by 75% in nine months through process redesign, metric creation and enhanced tooling 
•Partnered with Learning & Develop to create and implement the first standardized training academy in company history for all new FTE’s
•Partnered with Engineering to automate system logic on Submission to remove 100% of manual order assignments across all workflows 
•Designed, launched and manage the company's first Proficiency Based Program for the Benefit Operations Division in partnership with Human Resources for 400+ FTE’s
•Served as President for the LGBTQI+ employee resource group throughout 2020 & 2021
 
Key Responsibilities: 

•Management of four HI Benefit Operations Departments
•Direct empowerment of 10 Managers of Operations and 175+ Employees 
•Operational responsibility for 25,000+ customers and 100+ health insurance carriers across 30+ states within the US
•Stakeholder management (HR, Engineering, WorkForce Management, Recruiting, Process Improvement & Finance)   
•Implementation of scalable processes & automation, while growing, maintaining and enhancing company culture 
•Management of agency partnerships with APEX & AeroTek for seasonal contingent workforce

experience.title: Senior Director of Client Services
experience.summary:
Convey Health Solutions is a specialized healthcare technology and services company that provides purpose built solutions for 7 of the top 10 health plans in America, while serving over 8 million members annually. During my tenure at Convey, I successfully overhauled and established a scalable client service model that provided world class service for the entire enterprise, including: HealthScape Advisors, Pareto Intelligence, and Gorman Health Group. I was also a critical stakeholder in securing contract renewals across all of our top tier clients including Cigna Healthcare that aided in our ability to successfully IPO.  
 
Key Accomplishments: 

•Spearheaded remediation efforts resulting in two contract renewals totaling more than 120 million in revenue between 2019 - 2022
•Established a diverse and expansive professional development program for the Advanced Plan Administration Division
•Initiated and launched the “Face of Convey” campaign for the Advanced Plan Administration Division 
•Selected to participate in an internal “Leaders of the Future” global management education program
 
Key Responsibilities: 

•Complete client management of Cigna, OptumRX, Farm Bureau, Clover Health, and 20 other insurance and pharmacy benefit health plans
•Direct management of 7 Client Service Managers that are on-site/remote in Florida, Chicago and Nashville 
•Support and develop client relationships, operational partnerships and strategic alliances throughout the nation and Manila, Philippines
•Contract execution, SLA management and statement of work creation, including: negotiation, renewal and new streams of revenue 
•Management of all client events, strategic strategy sessions and quarterly business reviews
•Obtain and respond to all client feedback, thus driving an increase in overall client satisfaction and engagement
•Creation of a scalable client service model through division policies and procedures and measured performance metrics

experience.title: Director of Operations
experience.summary:
As the sole millennial member of the executive leadership team at CIOX Health, I lead with poise and vigor, while championing positive company culture with an emphasis on teamwork, innovation and growth over time. 

Key Accomplishments: 

2018
● 3.6 Million dollar increase in operational budget and responsibility via regional territory realignment in 2018 
● 1st Region to fully implement and install AI Technology (HealthSource) in company history
● Selected to collaborate with GenPact and CIOX Health Senior Leadership to develop and enhance HealthSource in Jaipur, India
2017
● Achieved a 30% growth rate in new business throughout 2017, resulting in an additional $850,000 dollars to the annual revenue stream
● Retained 81% of existing “Premier At-Risk” clients in 2017 through contract renewals; equaling $8 million dollars of the annual revenue
● 1st In company history to accomplished HIMSS Stage 7 Certification – Point of Care Scanning at Memorial HealthCare System
● 20% Increase in units processed from 2016 to 2017
2016

Key Responsibilities: 

● Management of three lines of business: Release of Information, Document Imaging, HEDIS and Medicare Risk Adjustment Audits
● P&L responsibility of $15 million dollars annually with a projected growth of $1.5-2 million in 2018
● Direct management of 7 Regional Sr. Managers of Operation and 200 plus Employees that are positioned on-site/remote throughout Florida 
● Maintain client relationships and operational leadership visibility throughout the region, resulting in 75% travel throughout the year
● Maintain thorough knowledge of services offered to negotiate, gain and secure new/existing business contracts
● Interact and connect with key stakeholders at national and promotional events as a key company representative

experience.title: Senior Operations Manager
experience.summary:
Within the division I managed, our main objective was to assimilate and analyze data sent from our health plan provider offices. The ultimate goal was to deliver quality assured data to our clients, which enables them to manage member care and receive appropriate reimbursement. Altegra Health, now known as Changed Healthcare, operates the largest financial and administrative healthcare network in the US. Throughout my three years with Altegra Health, I played an integral role in the successful transition of two acquisitions: Outcomes Health Information Solutions and Changed Healthcare.

Key Accomplishments: 

•Risk Adjustment: 47% increase in units processed from 2013 to 2014 
•HEDIS: 23% increase in units processed from 2013 to 2014 
•RADV: Successful in meeting all deliverable's and process implementation 
•Successful collaboration with IT resulting in two re-engineered systems and one installation of new security protocol division wide
•Creation of division policies and procedures and measurable production metrics
•Promoted from Operations Manager to Clinical Operations Manager less than one year after hiring date

Key Responsibilities: 

•Management of three departments: Clinical Advocates, Clinical Readers, Clinical Callbacks
•Management of three lines of business: HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set), RA (Risk Adjustment) and RADV (Risk Adjustment Data Validation Audits)
•Operational management of clinical projects: 100 plus projects equaling 1.5 million-plus units per year
•Direct management of 1,000 plus employees that are positioned nationally (full time, part time and agency employees)
•Operational leadership and coordination of our US, Manila, and Puerto Rico offices
•Interviewing, on-boarding and off-boarding of all full-time employees within the division I manage
•Providing operational analysis and recommendations to the senior executive leadership
